Claim 26 (Currently amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is __ibuprofen, ketoprofen, naproxen, oxaprozin, diclofenac, etodolac, indomethacin, ketorolac, or aspirin__, wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved, __and wherein the composition is free of water__.

Claim 27 (Previously presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises from 20 wt.% to 60 wt.% phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 28 (Cancelled)

Claim 29 (Previously presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the weight ratio of NSAID to non-aqueous carrier is about 2:1 to about 1:2.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is __aspirin__.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is __selected from the group consisting of__ salicylate, ibuprofen, ketoprofen, naproxen, oxaprozin, diclofenac, etodolac, indomethacin, ketorolac, __and__ aspirin[[, or combinations thereof]].

Claim 32 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is __selected from the group consisting of__ aspirin, salicylate, diclofenac, naproxen, ibuprofen, __and__ indomethacin[[, or combinations thereof]].

Claim 33 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is __selected from the group consisting of__ lecithin, essential oil, vegetable oil, animal oils, vitamin A, vitamin D, vitamin E, fish oil, __and__ mixtures and combinations thereof, __wherein when the bio-compatible oil comprises lecithin, the lecithin provides additional phosphatidylcholine beyond the recited 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine__.

Claim 34 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 33, wherein the vegetable oil is __selected from the group consisting of__ peanut oil, canola oil, avocado oil, safflower oil, olive oil, corn oil, soy bean oil, sesame oil, __and__ mixtures and combinations thereof.

Claim 35 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is lecithin, __wherein the lecithin provides additional phosphatidylcholine beyond the recited 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine__.

Claim 36 (Cancelled)

Claim 37 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous composition of claim 26 further __comprising__ phosphatidylserine, phosphatidylethanolamine, sphingomyelin, dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine, or combinations thereof.

Claim 38 (Cancelled)

Claim 39 (Previously presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the composition does not include a solvent.

Claim 40 (Previously presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the composition does not include methanol, ethanol, or chloroform.

Claim 41 (Currently amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and aspirin NSAID, said aspirin NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of aspirin NSAID to biocompatible oil carrier of about 5:1 to about 1:5, __wherein the composition is free of water__.

Claim 42 (Previously presented): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 41 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 43 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 41 wherein the __biocompatible oil carrier comprises__ lecithin __that provides additional phosphatidylcholine beyond the recited phosphatidylcholine__.

Claim 44 (Currently amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and ibuprofen NSAID, said ibuprofen NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of ibuprofen NSAID to non-aqueous biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, __wherein the composition is free of water__.

Claim 45 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 44 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% __phosphatidylcholine__.

Claim 46 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 44 wherein the __biocompatible oil carrier comprises__ lecithin __that provides additional phosphatidylcholine beyond the recited phosphatidylcholine__.

Claim 47 (Currently amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and indomethacin NSAID, said indomethacin NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of indomethacin NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, __wherein the composition is free of water__.

Claim 48 (Previously presented): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 47 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 49 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 47 wherein the __biocompatible oil carrier comprises__ lecithin __that provides additional phosphatidylcholine beyond the recited phosphatidylcholine__.

Claim 50 (Currently amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and __aspirin__ NSAID, said __aspirin__ NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of __aspirin__ NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, __wherein the composition is free of water__.

Claim 51 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 52 (Currently amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 wherein the __biocompatible oil carrier comprises__ lecithin __that provides additional phosphatidylcholine beyond the recited phosphatidylcholine__.
